![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14062541/assets/043adf0ef683c24fbf4680145411d86fa94b52016bee44ac8f08ca7c5ca9f1b7.png)

Evaluate the triple integral 
${∭}_{R}24xy\,dV$
over the region $R,$ shown above.

*Hint: All surfaces, except for the top one, are parallel to the corresponding coordinate planes.*
worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14062541/assets/75a76a2dbc34c889335e66623e12b686eb9a255ee0d67f9be0e3792f2650360c.png)

 

Notice that our solid can be written as the type I region

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,(x,y)\in D,\,\,0\le z\le 4-x-y},
$$

where

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,\,0\le y\le 2}
$$

is the projection of $R$ onto the $xy$-plane, shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14062541/assets/dfa0a80bc323401f050d1302dc42c92558d8b566d9b0f985e955d34eb5cc15bd.png)

Hence, we can express the region $R$ as

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,\,0\le y\le 2,\,\,0\le z\le 4-x-y}.
$$

As a result, by writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}24xy\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{4-x-y}24xy\,dz\,dy\,dx.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z$, treating $x$ and $y$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{4-x-y}24xy\,dz\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{4-x-y}24xy\,dz]dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}[24xyz]_{z=0}^{z=4-x-y}\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}24xy(4-x-y)\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}(96xy-24{x}^{2}y-24x{y}^{2})\,dy\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}(96xy-24{x}^{2}y-24x{y}^{2})\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{2}(96xy-24{x}^{2}y-24x{y}^{2})\,dy]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[48x{y}^{2}-12{x}^{2}{y}^{2}-8x{y}^{3}]_{y=0}^{y=2}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(128x-48{x}^{2})\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}(128x-48{x}^{2})\,dx & =[64{x}^{2}-16{x}^{3}]_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =(64-16)-0 \\  & =48.\end{aligned}
$$
